name: Potassium citrate
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Start 60 mEq/day in 2 or 3 doses with meals
Start 30 mEq/day in 2 or 3 doses with meals; avoid above 100 mEq/day

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Anticholinergics and other drugs slowing gut transit

contraindications: Hyperkalemia or predisposing conditions (chronic renal failure, uncontrolled diabetes, acute dehydration, adrenal insufficiency, potassium-sparing drugs)
Delayed tablet passage (delayed gastric emptying, obstruction, anticholinergics)
monitoring: Potassium, creatinine, electrolytes, blood count every 4 months

pk.onset: Urinary citrate rises within 1 hour; lasts about 12 hours

sources.citation: Strides Pharma Inc. (2025). Potassium citrate extended-release tablets [Prescribing information; US FDA-approved label, ANDA206813, set ID 5f38b02c-703c-4fc2-b833-654e41bd617f, version effective July 1, 2025]. DailyMed, U.S. National Library of Medicine.

revision_log.change: Contraindication added: renal insufficiency with GFR <0.7 mL/kg/min (label 4).
